why: No params move can fix this. jaw_lips rest_area bottoms out at 2.5 cm2 and has no protrusion, so neither a seal nor rounding is possible anywhere in its range. round_lips gives an opening of 0-6.6 cm2, which seals for /p/ and allows a small rounded aperture for /u/. Its lip tube of 1 cm plus up to 1.6 cm of protrusion (I'm using the top of the range) lengthens the front cavity. Combined with the tongue pad at the back of the rail (8-10 cm), this should pull F2 down to about 850-1000 Hz and drop F1 for /u/. Cost: $4 for a pushrod kit, 2 days, 57 machine minutes. It uses the jaw servo plus the 1 servo on hand.

The cam_tongue rail_start range [2.5, 4] can never reach 1.5 cm, so /t/ needs a swap. tip_tongue adds a tip blade that slides 0.3-5 cm behind the teeth and can seal the full bore, which covers /t/. Setting the body pad stroke to 1.3 cm (above the 1.2 cm bore radius) lets it seal at the velar place for /k/. Keeping rail_start at 3.25 leaves the body pad covering 3.25-10.25 cm, the same as now. Two constrictions at once also give /er/ a later route to the F3 floor. Cost on its own: $12 (1 servo + 1 pushrod kit), 3 days, 76 machine minutes. If tried together with round_lips, I'd buy 2 servos and 2 pushrod kits for $24 total, 3 days, 133 machine minutes, using 6 of 6 controller channels.
